text:
The dentist who performed the root canal treatment did a great job and was always on time. I was truly impressed by that.

However, for other treatments with a different dentist, I had three appointments, and each time the dentist was late, resulting in waiting times of approximately 30 minutes to an hour.

The first two times, I tried to understand, assuming they were busy with previous cases or had other reasons, so I didn't make a big deal out of it. But the third time, I waited about 18 minutes, and when the dentist finally arrived, I overheard them saying they had gone shopping. I felt that a patient's time shouldn't be overlooked like that.

Another issue is the equipment used during treatments; it was quite substandard. Water from the instruments splashed onto my face and down my neck almost every time, making me uncomfortable and questioning why this happened so frequently.

Overall, the quality of some of the treatments was good, but punctuality and equipment need improvement.
